title: PH v0.4 Phase 0A Targeted-Access Identifiability Falsification Experiment

frozen_prior.status: NON_IDENTIFIABLE at the single shared-boundary node identity level under A0

primary_question: A1 selective local interventions J_V and J_Oを追加したとき、M0とscientifically constrained duplicated-state M11-Cのinterventional equivalenceを破れるか。

access.A0: Fast/Slow external interventions plus V/O observations
access.A1: A0 plus J_V and J_O local interventions near candidate boundary pathways
access.target_label_randomization: internal V/O parameter-slot labels are permuted per seed, identically across models, with no model-identity input

models.M0: one latent B shared by V and O
models.M11-U: unrestricted oracle duplicated-state clone; may copy M0 local effects and is a canary only
models.M11-C: duplicated Z_V/Z_O states with pre-frozen measured local leakage, shared innovation, and cross-output coupling bounds
models.M10: legacy maximal dynamic mimic without new local cross paths
models.M2: common driver without local cross paths

calibration.cross_talk_metric: norm(direct opposite-side actuator response) / norm(direct target-side actuator response)
calibration.result_blindness: all bounds are frozen before any M0/M11-C evaluation result is read

primary_endpoint.name: Gamma_cross
primary_endpoint.N_JV_to_O: minimum energy distance across preregistered cells between O under do(J_V=a) and do(J_V=0)
primary_endpoint.N_JO_to_V: minimum energy distance across preregistered cells between V under do(J_O=a) and do(J_O=0)
primary_endpoint.distance: normalized energy distance on fixed post-intervention trajectory signatures

identifiability_endpoint.name: Delta_ID_M11_C
identifiability_endpoint.definition: holdout interventional distribution distance between M0 and the best pre-fitted full constrained M11-C
identifiability_endpoint.structural_rule: within tolerance is NON_IDENTIFIABLE_UNDER_A1; do not rescue with classifier changes

required: test whether M11-C becomes equivalent as capacity increases
verify target randomization is independent of model identity

stop_rule: Any mandatory quality Gate failure stops Pilot interpretation and prohibits Confirmatory.
